items.topic: Final disposition: define, archive, or delete
items.context: After 4 rounds with no user engagement, this item appears to be either abandoned or a workflow test artifact. Keeping it in backlog adds noise. This is a streamlined version of the same question from rounds 1 and 4 — with a delete option added since archiving still retains the item.

options.label: Define it — I'll add a description and answer round-001 decisions
options.rationale: This is a real idea. User commits to providing spec.json description and answering foundational decisions (purpose, users, components, methodology, resources) before the next workshop round.

options.label: Archive it
options.rationale: Mark status as 'archived'. Preserves the item and its workshop history but removes it from active backlog. Can be un-archived later if needed.

options.label: Delete it
options.rationale: Remove the item entirely. Appropriate if this was purely a workflow test and the history has no value.
